newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Mineral Corp Ltd plans float.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Mineral Corp Ltd plans float.

text.p: Australian feldspar and garnet miner and industrial minerals marketer Minerals Corp Ltd (MCL) said on Thursday it plans to raise A$15 million through a float of 18.75 million shares at an issue price of 80 cents each.

The company said it would use the funds to expand capacity and improve its mining operations at Broken Hill, New South Wales, develop large deposits in eastern New South Wales and repay debt and the balance of acquisition monies.
The issue is fully underwritten by Burdett, Buckerige and Young Ltd. BBY Corporate Services is adviser to the issue.
"We expect to commence positive earnings growth with a A$2.9 million net profit in 1996/97 (to June 30)," chairman and chief executive Vic Alexander said in a statement.
MCL bought the Melbourne-based mineral processing business Minatek Pty Ltd in July 1995.

Minatek processes and markets minerals primarily to the plastics, PVC, paint and rubber markets. MCL said technological change was expected to produce substantial growth in this sector over the coming decade.

MCL also said it planned to expand its Radfords contract mining division which operates at Broken Hill. Radfords operates MCL's mine and provides contract mining services in western New South Wales, the company said.
